summary: Adds resumable tenant-scoped privacy execution for retention expiry, subject requests, legal holds and tenant deletion with explicit authoritative/derived/object-store targets and append-only evidence.

impacts.evidence: All workflows, holds, targets and evidence are organization/workspace scoped with forced RLS.
Task 061 executes Task-060 policies while keeping raw PII outside coordinator state; manual-review and legal holds fail closed.
No existing public HTTP/OpenAPI operation changes.
Existing privacy request event contracts remain compatible; no existing event payload changes.
Expand-only migration 000039 adds durable workflow, hold, target and append-only evidence state.
Destructive work is hold-aware, correction data is referenced rather than persisted, and derived-only destructive jobs are rejected.
manual_review retention is blocked and performs no automatic mutation.
Lifecycle changes emit legally-significant audit events and each target page appends checksum/count evidence.
Per-target versioned cursors do not advance on failed store calls, enabling deterministic resume.
No webhook or external egress surface is introduced.
Job/target states, processed counts and timestamps expose backlog/progress signals for Task 066.
Schema is expand-only; workers can be disabled without deleting job/evidence state and later resume from checkpoints.
Tests cover derived-store propagation, failed-page resume, holds, manual review and authoritative-target requirements.
